make_cal_v6: build a CalV6 color calibration module for a list of cameras with an identity camera
make_cal_v5: build a CalV5 color calibration module with grayscale and color learning rate scales
make_cal_v3: build a CalV3 color calibration module using per-camera 1x1 convolutional layers
calv6_forward: run the CalV6 forward pass to apply color calibration on a batch of images
calv5_initialize_from_texs: initialize CalV5 calibration parameters from texture statistics in a dataset
